text: This chapter introduces the technique of deriving 3-part chords from a 4-part spread cluster. The chapter is primarily a notation/voicing-grid reference with no substantive prose, focusing on chord voicing and reduction techniques through diagrammatic presentation. It closes the loop on the M-Lode derivation taxonomy established in Chapters 5–8, completing the picture that each 4-part chord family generates a characteristic set of 3-part voicings via voice-omission.
